coder_notes: Single-arm phase 1 of 177Lu-PSMA-617 given with standard adjuvant temozolomide after surgery and EBRT (adjuvant setting = newly_diagnosed). Active moiety given as development code psma-617 (no INN stated in record; isotope in drug_class_hint per W1). The 68Ga-PSMA PET is a registered diagnostic test; tracer named 68Ga-PSMA-11 in exclusion criteria, listed as diagnostic_agent with radiopharmaceutical true. Eligible population includes IDH-wildtype glioblastoma plus other IDH-wildtype grade 2-4 and H3-altered gliomas; H3 K27/G34 entities are alternative eligible diagnoses, not entry requirements, so not coded as biomarkers. PSMA IHC positivity is an entry requirement matched to the PSMA-targeted candidate.
